answer: What survives to the shale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The beacon holds work receipts rather than names, so the river of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit.
